task: Independent hydrodynamic-control attack for interacting stochastic systems

model.state: X_N=K_N/N in {0,1/N,...,1}; N conserved binary agents

claims.claim: For every c>=0, the density-dependent fluid drift is f_c(x)=kappa*(1-2x), so all models have the same ODE.
claims.scope: finite-time density-dependent scaling; fixed c and kappa

claims.claim: X_N converges uniformly in probability on each fixed interval [0,T] to the ODE solution when X_N(0) converges.
The Hamiltonian H_c(x,p)=b_c(x)(e^p-1)+d_c(x)(e^-p-1) and path action vary with c despite fixed drift.
claims.near_equilibrium: L_c(v)=v^2/(2g)+O(v^4); c=kappa gives v^2/(3*kappa), c=2*kappa gives v^2/(4*kappa).
claims.control_interface: predictable controlled channel intensities N*u_plus,N*u_minus; path derivative u_plus-u_minus; relative entropy is N times integrated channelwise Poisson entropy

claims.claim: For c>0 the stationary count law is symmetric beta-binomial with alpha_N=N*kappa/c; for c=0 it is Binomial(N,1/2). Its local stationary LDP rate depends on c.
claims.limit: local probabilities on neighborhoods shrink with exponent N*I_c(x); endpoints use continuous extension

claims.claim: Starting at X_N(0)->1/2, total flips J_N(T)/(N*T) converge in probability to kappa+c/2 for fixed T>0.
claims.discriminator: c=kappa versus c=2*kappa have limiting event rates 1.5*kappa and 2*kappa while the density trajectory is identically 1/2
claims.information_interface: requires resolved total flip counts; density-only observations do not identify c

failed_routes: A control law or fluctuation estimate based only on the fluid drift cannot distinguish c because the neutral-copying flux cancels from b-d.
Any statistic depending only on the limiting density trajectory is uninformative for c; a kinetic statistic such as jump activity is required.
Rare stationary-tail sampling is exponentially expensive; use total jump count for an ordinary-trajectory discriminator.
unknowns_and_limits: No novelty or priority claim; the model is an established noisy-voter/mass-action instance and the LLN/LDP machinery is standard.
Primary LDP paper theorem hypotheses and proof ranges were not audited from full text.
No spatial/local-correlation extension, arbitrary control-policy theorem, simulation, or external independent derivation was performed.
